item.text:
**Assessment**
Mixed, leaning negative. The public-service systems in health, education targeting, and social assistance were often run in a technocratic, broad-based way, but the wider 2024 record still shows strong patronage, dynastic politics, and loyalty-driven appointments. I did not find a clean 2024 example of Jokowi openly using food, housing, or welfare benefits as a direct loyalty/punishment instrument; the best negative evidence is indirect but persistent.

**Claims**
- [Indonesia](https://www.who.int/about/accountability/results/who-results-report-2024-2025/country-profile/2024/indonesia) — World Health Organization, 2024. Claim: WHO credits Indonesia with broad health coverage, lower out-of-pocket costs, better access regardless of gender/age/disability, and more efficient, results-oriented, transparent resource management. This supports a technocratic, non-clientelist reading of service delivery. IDs: 6B.7; also 6B.4, 6B.5, 6B.2.
- [Does Indonesia’s National Health Insurance Scheme mobile phone application, Mobile JKN, support health financing?](https://www.who.int/publications/i/item/9789240100893) — World Health Organization, 2024-12-06. Claim: Mobile JKN simplified registration and payments, improved informal-sector contribution collection, and lowered BPJS administrative costs. That points to service delivery by process improvement, not patronage gating. IDs: 6B.7; also 6B.4, 6B.5, 6B.2.
- [Less burden, better care: MoH and WHO accelerate JKN redistribution](https://www.who.int/indonesia/news/detail/29-10-2024-less-burden--better-care--moh-and-who-accelerate-jkn-redistribution) — WHO Indonesia, 2024-10-29. Claim: The ministry and WHO used workload ratios, quality standards, and continuous monitoring to redistribute patients and resources across primary-care providers, which is the opposite of loyalty-based allocation. IDs: 6B.7; also 6B.4, 6B.5, 6B.2.
- [BAPPENAS Perkuat Dukungan untuk Anak-Anak dan Keluarga Rentan](https://www.unicef.org/indonesia/id/press-releases/bappenas-perkuat-dukungan-untuk-anak-anak-dan-keluarga-rentan) — UNICEF Indonesia, 2024-04-25. Claim: Regsosek was presented as a data system to improve targeting, delivery, accountability, and transparency of social assistance for poor and vulnerable households. That is evidence for targeted administration rather than welfare as a loyalty reward. IDs: 6B.7; also 6B.4, 6B.5, 6B.2, 6B.3.
- [Blueprint get children back to school in Indonesia](https://www.unicef.org/indonesia/stories/blueprint-get-children-back-school-indonesia) — UNICEF Indonesia, 2024-08-23. Claim: The government-led back-to-school push returned nearly 37,000 children to learning and prevented about 149,000 dropouts since 2021, showing organized outreach aimed at children rather than a patronage-only channel. IDs: 6B.7; also 6B.4, 6B.2, 6B.3.
- [Indonesia’s climate ambitions gain boost through World Bank-supported land administration and spatial planning reform](https://www.worldbank.org/en/news/press-release/2024/09/30/indonesia-s-climate-ambitions-gain-boost-through-world-bank-supported-land-administration-and-spatial-planning-reform) — World Bank, 2024-09-30. Claim: The reform was meant to strengthen land tenure security, simplify licensing, reduce disputes, and improve productive investment; that is broad, rules-based administration, not an obvious loyalty filter. IDs: 6B.7; also 6B.5, 5B.6.
- [Outgoing Indonesian president gives cabinet jobs to loyalists of successor Prabowo](https://theprint.in/world/outgoing-indonesian-president-gives-cabinet-jobs-to-loyalists-of-successor-prabowo/2228867/) — Reuters via ThePrint, 2024-08-19. Claim: Jokowi appointed people close to Prabowo into cabinet roles, which is direct evidence that jobs and offices were still being used in a network-smoothing, patronage-heavy way rather than a pure merit model. IDs: 6B.7; also 6B.4, 5B.5.
- [Analysis: A decade of Jokowi, Indonesia’s democracy icon leaves illiberal legacy, critics say](https://theprint.in/world/analysis-a-decade-of-jokowi-indonesias-democracy-icon-leaves-illiberal-legacy-critics-say/2310394/) — Reuters via ThePrint, 2024-10-14. Claim: Reuters’ end-of-term analysis says Jokowi left patronage, dynastic politics, and weaker institutional integrity, which is the strongest broad negative background evidence against a clean separation between public benefits and political loyalty. IDs: 6B.7; also 6B.4, 5B.5.
- [World Bank Group debars PT LPPSLH Konsultan](https://www.worldbank.org/en/news/press-release/2024/07/10/world-bank-group-debars-pt-lppslh-konsultan) — World Bank, 2024-07-10. Claim: The bank found overbilling and improper hiring of a project official’s family member, concrete evidence that favoritism persisted inside development implementation. IDs: 6B.7; also 6B.4, 5B.5.

**Gap**
I did not find a 2024 source explicitly showing Jokowi withholding food, housing, permits, or welfare benefits from opponents as a formal tool of political punishment. The evidence is mostly indirect: technocratic service systems on one side, and broader patronage, dynastic politics, and loyalty-driven appointments on the other.
